lineup_blocks_source_fields.name: lineup_blocks_source_fields
lineup_blocks_source_fields.value:
case "lineup_blocks"."source"
        when 'SUBMISSIONS' then "lineup_blocks"."submission_type" is not null and "lineup_blocks"."per_visit" is not null and "lineup_blocks"."program_id" is null
        when 'PROGRAM' then "lineup_blocks"."program_id" is not null and "lineup_blocks"."submission_type" is null and "lineup_blocks"."per_visit" is null
      end

submission_event_banners_template_fields.name: submission_event_banners_template_fields
submission_event_banners_template_fields.value: "submission_event_banners"."mode" <> 'TEMPLATE' or ("submission_event_banners"."occasion" is not null and "submission_event_banners"."message" is not null)

submissions_poster_fields.name: submissions_poster_fields
submissions_poster_fields.value: "submissions"."type" <> 'POSTER' or ("submissions"."category_id" is not null and "submissions"."asset_id" is not null)
